control_flow: avoidWalls: if RLIGHT is below 60 %, check the front and left obstacle sensors; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
In the dark: a front obstacle makes it turn left 15°; else a left obstacle makes it turn right 15°; else it calls driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the front obstacle sensor sees something, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: In a dark bending tunnel, turn right when a wall is close on the left and left when one is close on the right, so the robot gets through without touching the walls.

RLIGHT is 60 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark

branches.outcome: the front sensor sees something: it turns left 15°

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: LLIGHT is below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
LLIGHT is 70 % or more: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: the front obstacle sensor sees something

branches.outcome: the front sensor sees something: it stops
the front sensor sees nothing: it calls followLine
